verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a framework you install with pip from its public GitHub repo and run in your own Python environment. AutoGen Studio adds exporting teams to Python code, setting up endpoints from a team configuration, and running teams in a Docker container, so the core product runs entirely on user-controlled infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, in-depth self-hosted deployment or operations docs beyond brief feature bullets, and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
